name: PR findings: severity tally, the severity filter, and the filtered card count
description:
From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and exercise the FINDINGS feature end to end against seeded data. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner, the severity tally and the FindingCard list are all revealed without an extra click. The seed gives #482 exactly 1 CRITICAL + 2 WARNING + 1 SUGGESTION, which is what makes the tally assertions meaningful: a single finding per level could not tell a real counter apart from a hardcoded '1'.

Two agent-browser landmines shape this flow. (1) `find ... click` SILENTLY NO-OPS on an element below the fold — it prints '✓ Done' and exits 0 while the click never lands, so every earlier revision of this flow passed without ever applying the filter. Hence the `scrollintoview` before the filter click, and the `get count [data-finding-id]` assertions, which fail loudly if the filter did nothing. (2) `find text` is case-INSENSITIVE substring matching, so `find text "Warning"` is ambiguous between the tally pill ('2 WARNING'), the timeline chip and the filter button. The filter is therefore addressed by role + exact accessible name, which only the filter button carries ('Warning'); the timeline chips read '2 Warning findings'.

Read-only seeded data (no model call).
